Gideon, the first report in this channel was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant.

In the meantime, per your 10:42 message, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. Your 11:08 post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

This is based only on what's in this channel. If you reported it earlier elsewhere, such as by email or in another channel, I can't see that from here.
